OPERATIONS: Observer pipe/FD close and timeout accounting
EFFECTIVE_POLICY.POLICY: Independently derive exact operation/handle/concurrency event counts before active entry; include all simultaneously feasible secondaries in reserve. Mutually exclusive primary outcomes are not summed as concurrent.
EFFECTIVE_POLICY.REPEATED_WRITES: Every new record/republication charges full logical length again; suffix continuation of same admitted artifact is not a new record. No automatic probe retry or new audit campaign.
EFFECTIVE_POLICY.UNEXPECTED_OR_OVERFLOW: Additional unmodelled/missing secondary witness makes outcome INCOMPLETE; record bounded overflow via reserved slot if possible. Never claim complete errors from truncated/unverifiable exception text.

FAILURES.CONCURRENT_POSSIBILITY: Can coexist with another producer failure during stop/observer/publication finalization
FAILURES.FIRST_CAUSAL_FAILURE_RELATION: May not replace primary immutable cause
FAILURES.MISSING: Exact operation/handle/write-attempt controller cardinality and independent witness bounds
FAILURES.MUTUAL_EXCLUSIVITY: Do not sum unrelated alternative first causes; within a feasible path all owned operation errors must be included
FAILURES.PUBLICATION_CHARGE: 743 per approved112 bounded secondary record plus actual independent causal witness/framing; actual multiplicity unsealed
